question: Does the equally weighted centroid of the three pair-stress log-expression means predict the triple-stress endpoint better than the control mean, with positive gain outside the fitted full single-stress span?
scope: Narrowed three-factor same-species separate-experiment test; not exact replication of CODE3-5 four-factor selected-donor result, not independent-laboratory or crop validation.
replicate_unit: Biological RNA library from pooled seedlings; no cross-treatment matched blocks assumed.
feature_filter: Mean FPKM across CT and three single-stress conditions (12 non-target libraries) >= threshold; no target-dependent gene exclusion.
span: Unscaled SVD of the three single-condition mean log-expression displacements from the CT mean; retain full numerical rank <= 3, with standard machine-precision rank tolerance.
donor_rule: Equal mean of all three observed pair-condition mean log-expression vectors; no donor selection or fitted shrinkage.

model_formulas.second_order_factorial: M_SE + M_SH + M_EH - M_S - M_E - M_H + C

primary_metric: Mean squared error across retained genes, averaged equally over the three target RNA libraries
secondary_metric: Mean absolute error by target library and mean
decomposition: The full-centroid squared-error gain over C equals within-span gain plus outside-span gain by orthogonality; quantify each per target library and in the mean.

disjoint_control_diagnostic.filter: Mean FPKM across only the 9 single-stress libraries >= each threshold
disjoint_control_diagnostic.basis: For each of the three CT libraries k, fit the full span of three single-condition log-expression means minus CT_k
disjoint_control_diagnostic.references: Use the other two CT libraries as distinct donor/target references and average both assignments; freeze bases, donor vectors and reference vectors before target parsing
disjoint_control_diagnostic.covariance_correction: For donor squared norm subtract sum over three pair conditions of projected sample-covariance trace / (9*n_pair*G). For target squared norm subtract projected target sample-covariance trace/(n_target*G). No donor-target correction because pair and triple libraries are disjoint. Separate CT references avoid a shared-reference covariance term.
disjoint_control_diagnostic.margin: 2*B_donor,target - B_donor,donor for within/outside/full spaces; retain negative corrected values
disjoint_control_diagnostic.limitation: Overlapping CT folds are descriptive sensitivity checks, not independent replications. Noisy estimated single-stress span is not the true biological lower-order subspace.

requirements: Full-centroid mean MSE gain over control > 0
Outside-span contribution > 0 in each of the 3 target libraries
Covariance-corrected outside margin > 0 in each of the 3 disjoint-control folds
primary_support_criterion.interpretation: If all hold: descriptive support for the narrowed external three-factor hypothesis. Failure of any criterion cannot be rescued by mutant, threshold or alternate model. Report all metrics regardless.

baseline_reporting: Always report additive and second-order-factorial errors; no claim of predictive superiority unless the observed comparison supports it. Outside-only is an explanatory decomposition fixed before opening.
algebraic_limit: The second-order predictor outside the full single-effect span is exactly 3 times the pair-centroid outside displacement. Transferable outside-span structure is not evidence of a third-order interaction.
inference: No p-values from genes, no gene-level bootstrap as biological replication, no mechanistic or pure high-order interaction claim, no winner selection across genotypes.
opening_boundary: Download and hash original bytes; inspect header only to map columns. Parse only the 21 non-target numeric columns per genotype during freeze. Freeze all models, genes, bases, diagnostic assets and code/protocol/source hashes for both genotypes and all thresholds before a separate evaluate command reads any target numeric columns. Source-wide author preprocessing can still couple libraries.

exclusions.GSE294808: Excluded before expression acquisition: unresolved CT1/CT2 context and source-processing discrepancies.
exclusions.GSE203331: Structurally eligible but deferred; prior reanalysis history unresolved, no expression values opened in this stage.

changes_after_opening: Record any corrections or additional analyses explicitly; never silently revise primary criterion or model after opening.
